text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The government coalition parties back the idea of setting up a council, which would appoint the heads of courts and strengthen their independence from politics.
- The government discusses plans about a controversial amendment of the law on farmland, which may allow foreigners to buy Hungarian land under certain conditions.
- Postabank plans to raise its registered capital by some 20 billion forints this year.
- The government is likely to decide on aid to Told, a village in northern Hungary hit by serious storm damages recently.
